Screening aid built on LOTUS-FEA numerical results. No clinical validation. A converged or passing result does not establish grip, comfort, or tissue safety. This page runs no finite element solve: it replays and interpolates saved FEA fields and evaluates closed-form estimates.

How the numbers are derived

Full derivations with worked numbers are in the repository README (“Mathematical model”). Constants live in CONST and RESULTS at the top of this page's script.

QuantityFormulaConstants and basis
Mass lost with the limbmlost = M (0.0145 + 0.0465 f)foot 1.45%, shank 4.65% of body mass (Winter segment fractions); f = shank fraction removed
Standing weight W(M − mlost + mp) gg = 9.81 m/s²
Stance load into the socketF(%) = max(0, a(%) W − mp g)a(%) double hump, peaks 1.2 (GAIT_CURVE) → 923 N for the team patient
Swing pull-outF(%) = −s(%) mp (g + ω² r)ω = 6.5 rad/s, r = 0.30 m → 34 N peak
Sit-to-standF(%) = asts(%) Wpeak 0.6 W ≈ 470 N
Pad normal forceN = kN TkN = 8.1 (V5 tube-lace FEA run)
Petal friction capacityFpetals = μ kN Tμ screening value
Stance capacityFpetals / (1 − sd)sd = 0.15 design limit (friction mode)
Pull-out capacityFpetalsthe distal end cannot resist pull-off
Margincapacity / |F|slip below 1, target 1.3
Field at tension Tlinear interpolation between saved FEA states in T; above the last solved state, that state is shown unchangedflagged NOT SOLVED; never extrapolated
Field under stance loadtension field + interpolation of the push increments by axial loadpush increments up to 642 N above tightening (25 lbf run, 10 mm push); held beyond that and flagged
Peak pressure (beyond fields)cpk (kN,FEA T + ct Fpetals,axial) / AA = 26 233 mm², kN,FEA = 8.7, cpk = 13.0, ct = 1.3 (25 lbf run)
Pressure gradientmax over skin edges of |pi − pj| / |xi − xj|on the displayed FEA field
Verification vs validation

Verification (equations solved correctly)

LOTUS-FEA runs 47 benchmark checks (rlfea verify) against analytical or independent references, and every run checks equilibrium and element inversion. The muscle incompressibility check is reproducible with scripts/muscle_incompressibility_check.py. This page's arithmetic is the closed-form set listed above.

Validation (model represents a real limb)

None done. Tissue properties are literature fits from other subjects, the limb is CAD built from MRI-based approximations, friction is a screening value, contact is penalty-based, and the gait loads are textbook estimates. No socket has been bench- or patient-tested against these numbers.
